avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone-mediated potassium excretion; combined use increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless specifically prescribed; monitor serum K+ levels regularly

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs impair renal function and reduce antihypertensive efficacy; combined use increases acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid chronic NSAID use; use acetaminophen as alternative; if necessary, monitor renal function and K+

avoid_supplements.name: Enalapril, Lisinopril, or other ACE inhibitors
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Concurrent ACE inhibitor use results in excessive bradykinin accumulation and duplicative mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; ensure patient is on single ACE inhibitor therapy only

caution_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Garlic may have modest blood pressure-lowering effects; additive hypotensive effect possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; dose adjustment may be needed if combined use causes excessive hypotension

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hawthorn may potentiate vasodilation and blood pressure reduction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for dizziness or hypotension; inform prescriber of concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Ginger (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose ginger may have mild blood pressure-lowering effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; no dose adjustment typically needed at culinary doses

avoid_foods.name: High-potassium foods (in excess)
avoid_foods.mechanism: ACE inhibitors reduce potassium excretion; excessive dietary potassium increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on potassium-restricted diet if serum K+ elevated; include bananas, oranges, spinach, tomatoes in moderation; monitor K+ levels

caution_foods.name: Salt substitutes (potassium-based)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potassium-based salt substitutes increase dietary potassium intake
caution_foods.action: Use standard salt or low-sodium alternatives without potassium; counsel patient to avoid potassium-containing salt substitutes

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and blood pressure at baseline and periodically during therapy. Educate patient on hyperkalemia symptoms (weakness, palpitations) and advise avoidance of NSAIDs and potassium supplements.
